title: GAP Waiver Addenda Cancellation Events, Effective Dates and Processing Periods
content:
The terms below are the same in every GAP Waiver Addenda plan. They set which events cancel an addendum, the date each cancellation takes effect, and how quickly the refund follows.

## Events that cancel an addendum

| Event | Treatment under every plan |
|---|---|
| Contract paid off before maturity | the company cancels the addendum automatically |
| Repossessed vehicle sold | the addendum cancels |
| Contract unwound | the addendum is voided with a full refund |
| Borrower's own request | the cancellation needs a cancellation request signed by the borrower |

## Effective date by reason

| Reason for cancellation | Effective date |
|---|---|
| Borrower's voluntary cancellation | the date the signed request was received |
| Early payoff | the contract's closed date |
| Sale of the repossessed vehicle | the vehicle sale date |
| Contract unwound | the contract's closed date |
| Claim denied | the date of loss |

## Processing periods

- A refund on a company-initiated cancellation is issued within 30 calendar days after the cancellation effective date.
- A cancellation request sent for signature stays open for 10 calendar days.
- A refund on a voluntary cancellation is issued within 15 calendar days after the signed cancellation request.

*Hypothetical reading.* A contract closes on payoff on a given day. The addendum's cancellation is effective that same closed date, and its refund falls due within the 30 calendar days that follow.
